properties.headline: Special Weather Statement issued October 21 at 4:19PM PDT by NWS Reno NV
properties.description:
At 419 PM PDT, Doppler radar was tracking a strong thunderstorm over
Washoe City, or 7 miles northeast of Incline Village, moving
northwest at 30 mph.

HAZARD...Wind gusts up to 40 mph and accumulating hail up to a half
inch in diameter.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects. Minor damage to outdoor objects is
possible.

Locations impacted include...
Reno, Incline Village, Verdi, Boca Reservoir, Galena, Washoe City,
Caughlin Ranch, Floriston, Pleasant Valley, Mogul, New Washoe City,
Northwest Reno, Somersett, Incline Village-Crystal Bay, Verdi-Mogul
and Hirschdale.
properties.instruction:
Monitor the weather situation closely and be alert for threatening
weather conditions.

Torrential rainfall is also occurring with this storm and may lead to
flash flooding. Do not drive your vehicle through flooded roadways.

NWSheadline: A STRONG THUNDERSTORM WILL IMPACT THE CENTRAL CARSON CITY AND SOUTHERN WASHOE COUNTY UNTIL 5 PM PDT
